text:
Alicia: Heads up — landing in Austin tomorrow night around 11pm. Who's up for an empanada/taco shuttle on 6th? I know some spots stay late.
Sam: omg yes. El Primo taco trailer on 6th & Brazos is open late, fuego al pastor :fire: 
Josh: not necessarily empanadas but Torchy's on 6th is 24/7? depends on location. Also Veracruz has a migas plate that'll cure jetlag.
Lina: if you want something quick and walkable, 'Taqueria La Luz' does walk-up orders til 1am. small, cash-preferred.
Maya: vote: tacos vs empanadas? :raised_hands: 
Alicia: tacos 7 / empanadas 2 (so far) — I'll take the tacos crew. Anyone need a ride from the hotel? @Josh?
Josh: I can scoop 2 people. meet at hotel lobby 11:15. carpool? :oncoming_automobile: 
Sam: I'll bring napkins and hand sanitizer :sweat_smile: 
FoodBot: FYI — Austin transit schedule:
```
Nite Owl 10 min headway after 11pm on 6th St (route 3)
Rideshare surge likely after live shows
```
Lina: pro tip: bring cash for the trailer, and exact change speeds things up.
Alicia: awesome, see y'all. If more people want in, drop a thumbs. :thumbsup: 
Maya: +1
Jordan: wish I could — on call, raincheck pls
Sam: ok I'll take orders for extra tacos, message me menu picks
Alicia: final count: Alicia, Josh, Sam, Lina, Maya (5). Meeting 11:15 at lobby. ping if running late.
Josh: copying the address: 123 Market St (hotel). See y'all.
Lina: photo will be posted in #random later :camera_with_flash: 
Alicia: thanks all — midnight taco convoy, legendary :taco:
